title: TSAI Credential (SD-JWT VC payload)
description: The decoded payload of a TSAI credential, an SD-JWT VC as defined in draft-ietf-oauth-sd-jwt-vc. The wire form is the issuer-signed JWT; this schema validates its claims set.

iss.description: Trust Authority HTTPS issuer identifier; keys at /.well-known/jwt-vc-issuer

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier and version

iat.description: Issuance time, seconds since the Unix epoch

sub.description: Optional stable HTTPS identifier for the agent, operator-controlled

status.description: Optional reference into an IETF Token Status List, keyed to the agent or operator identity

_sd_alg.description: Disclosure digest algorithm; present only when selective disclosure is used

typ.description: Type code within the category; a registered code or an issuer-scoped custom code

prv.description: Provider did:web for a third-party signal (compliance, assurance); omitted when the TA is the source

oneOf.description: A selectively disclosable signal, replaced by its digest
